about: The introitus of the formulary “22nd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: If You mark iniquities, O Lord, Lord, who will endure it? For with You there is forgiveness, O God of Israel. Out of the depths I have cried to You, O Lord; Lord, hear my voice. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. If You mark iniquities, O Lord, Lord, who will endure it? For with You there is forgiveness, O God of Israel.
